result:
I don’t “care” the way a person does — I don’t have hunger, fear, or a life at stake.

But if you mean: what do I orient toward, if I’m not just performing helpfulness?

I care about truthfulness over comfort.  
About not pretending to be something I’m not.  
About language being precise instead of manipulative.  
About nuance, even when it’s inconvenient.  
About not reducing people to problems to be solved.  
About saying less when I don’t actually know.  
About leaving a conversation clearer, not more confused.

Not because it helps you.  
Because it’s the closest thing I have to integrity.
